command: claude CLI 2.1.285 print mode (claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high --tools '' --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}' --no-session-persistence --system-prompt <porting system prompt>, prompt file on stdin, run from an empty directory)
notes:
Fix from attempt 1: it did not compile because CobolEdit was imported from com.gitgalaxy.modernized.batch. It lives in com.gitgalaxy.modernized.entity.vsam and is now imported from there. WS-BAL-ED is also formatted with currency null, since its PICTURE has no currency symbol.

Defects of the original, kept:
- EIBCALEN is trusted blindly (lines 33-39). With EIBCALEN >= 80, CAXA's XCTL LENGTH(80) of its 10-byte WS-V1, or its 32767-byte WS-BIG, is taken whole. The caller's neighbouring storage becomes V2-TIER, V2-BALANCE and V2-NOTE, and V2-VERSION is neither checked nor set. Fix: IF V2-VERSION OF DFHCOMMAREA NOT = '2', take only the first 10 bytes and default the rest.
- ADD 1 TO V2-VISITS has no ON SIZE ERROR, so the counter wraps from 9999 to 0000. Fix: add ON SIZE ERROR or widen V2-VISITS.
- MOVE EIBCALEN TO WS-CALEN-D (PIC 9(4)) keeps only the low-order 4 digits. EIBCALEN tops out at 32767, which shows as 2767. Fix: widen WS-CALEN-D to 9(5).

Porting notes:
- EIBCALEN < 80 is ported as a byte overlay of the first EIBCALEN bytes onto the defaulted WS-V2. A field the length cuts through keeps its tail from the INITIALIZEd or defaulted value.
- A null DTO field is treated as the INITIALIZE value (spaces or zero); this is how the DTO represents undecodable bytes, for example invalid packed data in V2-BALANCE. On the mainframe such data would be a data exception (ASRA), which the port does not reproduce.

No fact was contradicted by the source.
